phases.name: Fix the silent zero on the rebuild path

steps.name: Refuse an empty or unreadable --in rather than writing an empty workbook (RED)
criteria: harvest.mjs --in <dir> --out <f> against a directory holding no message JSON exits non-zero and writes NOTHING to --out.
An existing file at --out is left byte-identical when the run refuses.
harvest.mjs --in <missing-dir> refuses with a readable one-line message naming the directory — no Node stack trace.
harvest.mjs --in .cache/messages (the month-sharded cache root) harvests all messages the shards hold.
The walking-skeleton acceptance test still passes 8/8 against flat fixtures/linkedin.
steps.scenario_name: a rebuild that finds no messages refuses instead of reporting success
steps.implementation_notes: Write the failing acceptance test ONLY in this step; the fix is 01-02. See docs/feature/fix-reparse-silent-zero/rca.md for the reproduction and the causal chain. Drive the CLI as a subprocess the way tests/acceptance/job-alert-harvester/walking-skeleton.test.mjs already does (execFileSync on node src/cli/harvest.mjs), so the test exercises the real exit code and the real filesystem effect rather than a unit seam. Assert on exit status AND on the absence or byte-identity of the --out file: 'wrote nothing' is the criterion that actually protects the user's tracker. Build the sharded-root case from a temp directory containing <tmp>/2026-09/<id>.json so the test does not depend on the gitignored personal .cache/, and give the empty case a directory that exists but holds no JSON. Expect RED on every assertion — the CLI currently exits 0 and writes a 10KB empty workbook.

steps.name: One listing reach, and a probe on the --in branch (GREEN)
criteria: readAll() walks subdirectories, as ids() already does — the adapter has one reach, not two.
The --in branch probes its input before reading and refuses on a missing directory with a readable message.
The --in branch refuses when the harvest yields zero messages, writing nothing to --out.
The success path is unchanged: --in .cache/messages/2026-09 and --in fixtures/linkedin both still report their real counts and write their workbook.
tests/acceptance/job-alert-harvester/reparse-refuses-empty.test.mjs passes, and the walking skeleton stays 8/8.
steps.scenario_name: a rebuild that finds no messages refuses instead of reporting success
steps.implementation_notes: Fix per rca.md § Proposed Fix. Three changes: (1) readAllIn in src/adapters/json-message-reader.mjs:11 gains { recursive: true } and joins against the returned relative path, mirroring idsIn at line 18 — note readdirSync recursive returns paths WITH their subdirectory prefix, so join(root, name) is required and the existing .sort() should still give a stable order; (2) the --in branch in src/cli/harvest.mjs:152 probes the directory first and refuses cleanly if absent or unreadable; (3) it refuses when messages.length === 0. NOTHING may be written to --out on any refusal path — writeWorkbook must not be reached, since a refusal that already clobbered the target is not a refusal. Keep the refusal messages on stderr and the exit code non-zero. src/adapters/ owns I/O so the probe belongs there or in the CLI, never in src/core/.
